metadata.description: Antarctic Digital Twin 1-day minute-level simulated dataset - Bharati Station

generated_range.granularity: 1 minute (1440 records/day for environment, energy, equipment x3, loads x5, logistics x4); maintenance is event-based

metadata.notes: All records are simulated for hackathon/prototype use. Station identity/location fields are real (NCPOR). No real minute-level historical sensor telemetry is publicly available for this station.
